about: ELIOS camera-calibration ground truth (simulation). Run the same G-code on the real arm, detect the same tag at each M240 and compare capture by capture.

frames.base: arm base, mm; Z up, arm faces -Y at home
frames.cal: arm1 = base rotated by theta1 about Z (the camera rides on arm1)
frames.cam: OpenCV: x right, y down, z forward, mm
frames.pixels: (row, col), origin at the centre of the top-left pixel

tag.corner_order: TL, TR, BR, BL as the detector reads the tag

meta.frame: arm1 = base rotated by theta1 about Z; p_cal = Rz(-theta1) p_base

gcode.text:
; ELIOS startup camera calibration · AprilTag on the gripper
; Target: tag36h11 id 5, black square 20.0 mm (print the PNG at 32.4 mm),
; on the paddle clamped in the gripper, print facing back at the camera.
; Fit the paddle before running. M240 = capture a camera frame here.
G21 G90 G17            ; mm, absolute, XY arc plane
M3 S70                 ; clamp the paddle (raise S for a thinner paddle)
G4 P500
G1 X0 Y-42.5 Z90 A0 B0 F600   ; initial pose, level wrist, no roll
G1 Y-80 Z90 F600       ; ease the paddle out to the first depth

; Depth 1 · wrist Y-80, tag ~90 mm from the lens
G1 Y-80 Z70 F600
G4 P400
M240
G1 Z90
G4 P400
M240
G1 Z110
G4 P400
M240
G1 Z130 B-60 F400      ; roll rides the lift, <= 20 deg/s
G4 P400
M240
G1 Z110 A-20 F600
G4 P400
M240
G1 Z90 A20 B60 F200    ; roll back through level, slowly
G4 P400
M240
G1 Z70 A0 F600
G4 P400
M240
G1 Z60 A10             ; slight nose-down keeps J4 clear of its -25 deg stop
G4 P400
M240

; Depth 2 · wrist Y-110, tag ~120 mm
G1 Y-110 Z60 A0 F600
G4 P400
M240
G1 Z80 A20
G4 P400
M240
G1 Z90 A0
G4 P400
M240
G1 Z120 B0
G4 P400
M240
G1 Z140 B-60 F400
G4 P400
M240
G1 Z110 A-20 F600
G4 P400
M240

; Depth 3 · wrist Y-140, tag ~150 mm
G1 Y-140 A0
G4 P400
M240
G1 Z150
G4 P400
M240
G1 Z130 A20 B0 F400
G4 P400
M240
G1 Z100 A0 F600
G4 P400
M240
G1 Z70
G4 P400
M240
G1 Z90 A20 B60 F400
G4 P400
M240
G1 Z50 A0 F600
G4 P400
M240

; Return: level the wrist on the way back, then the initial pose
G1 Y-80 Z90 A0 B0 F600
G1 Y-42.5 Z90 F600
M30                    ; paddle stays clamped: M5 by hand once it is held
